messages.subject: Multi variables plots
parts:
Hello,

This is a bit off-topic but I thought I asked anyway.
What would be the best way to plot a given trait from multiple lines (> 50) across time? I normally use a color of the parents and another for the RILs but the plot is still messy.
Any thoughts?
Thanks
L

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Multi variables plots
parts:
It depends on what you're trying to show. One approach is to use light gray for the individual lines, and then the parents with darker colors. Another would be to use a heat map.

When you get beyond ~20 curves, plotting the individual curves becomes a mess.

Maybe take a look at Figures 3 and 4 in this paper: https://www.biostat.wisc.edu/~kbroman/publications/gough.pdf

karl
